points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 亚历山德罗·伏打出生于意大利科莫的一个贵族家庭。他在家乡接受了早期教育，显示出对科学的浓厚兴趣。伏打在科莫的耶稣会学校学习，随后进入帕维亚大学和皇家修道院学习。这段时期奠定了他的科学基础，特别是对电学现象的初步探索。科莫的宁静环境和对知识的尊重氛围，培养了他严谨的科学态度和对自然现象的好奇心。
points.descriptionEn: Alessandro Volta was born into an aristocratic family in Como, Italy. He received his early education in his hometown, showing a strong interest in science. Volta studied at the Jesuit school in Como, later attending the University of Pavia and the Royal Seminary. This period laid the foundation for his scientific knowledge, particularly his initial explorations into electrical phenomena. The tranquil environment of Como and its respect for knowledge fostered his rigorous scientific attitude and curiosity about natural phenomena.

points.title: 科学启蒙
points.description: 1774年，伏打开始在科莫皇家学校教授物理学。他发明了起电盘(electrophorus)，这是一种能够连续产生静电的装置，为他赢得了国际声誉。这一发明展示了伏打对电学现象的深刻理解和创新思维。在科莫期间，他开始系统研究电学现象，发表了一系列关于电学的论文，并与欧洲各地的科学家建立了通信联系。科莫成为他科学事业的起点，也是他形成独特科学方法的重要时期。
points.descriptionEn: In 1774, Volta began teaching physics at the Royal School in Como. He invented the electrophorus, a device that could continuously generate static electricity, earning him international reputation. This invention demonstrated Volta's deep understanding of electrical phenomena and innovative thinking. During his time in Como, he began systematically studying electrical phenomena, publishing a series of papers on electricity, and establishing correspondence with scientists across Europe. Como became the starting point of his scientific career and an important period for forming his unique scientific methods.

points.title: 学术巅峰
points.description: 1779年，伏打被任命为帕维亚大学的实验物理学教授，并在此工作了近40年。在帕维亚期间，他进行了大量关于电学、化学和气体学的研究。他发现了甲烷(可燃空气)，并研究了气体的膨胀和压缩。伏打还发明了验电器(electroscope)和起电盘的改进版本。这一时期是伏打学术生涯的巅峰，他培养了许多杰出的学生，并与欧洲科学界保持密切联系。帕维亚大学为他提供了理想的研究环境和学术平台，使他能够充分发挥自己的科学才能。
points.descriptionEn: In 1779, Volta was appointed professor of experimental physics at the University of Pavia, where he worked for nearly 40 years. During his time in Pavia, he conducted extensive research on electricity, chemistry, and pneumatics. He discovered methane (inflammable air) and studied the expansion and compression of gases. Volta also invented the electroscope and improved versions of the electrophorus. This period marked the peak of Volta's academic career, where he trained many outstanding students and maintained close connections with the European scientific community. The University of Pavia provided him with an ideal research environment and academic platform, allowing him to fully develop his scientific talents.

points.title: 电学突破
points.description: 1800年，伏打发明了世界上第一个电池——伏打电堆(Voltaic Pile)。这一革命性发明首次提供了持续稳定的电流，为电学研究开辟了新纪元。同年，他在法国科学院展示了这一发明，引起了科学界的轰动。拿破仑·波拿巴对伏打的工作给予了高度评价，授予他金质奖章和伯爵头衔，并邀请他到巴黎展示他的发明。在巴黎期间，伏打与法国科学家进行了深入交流，进一步完善了他的电池设计。这一发明奠定了电化学和电磁学的基础，对后来的科学发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1800, Volta invented the world's first battery—the Voltaic Pile. This revolutionary invention provided the first continuous and stable electric current, opening a new era for electrical research. In the same year, he demonstrated this invention at the French Academy of Sciences, causing a sensation in the scientific community. Napoleon Bonaparte highly praised Volta's work, awarding him a gold medal and the title of Count, and inviting him to Paris to demonstrate his invention. During his time in Paris, Volta engaged in in-depth discussions with French scientists, further improving his battery design. This invention laid the foundation for electrochemistry and electromagnetism, having a profound impact on subsequent scientific development.

points.title: 晚年荣光
points.description: 1815年，伏打回到家乡科莫，被任命为帕维亚大学哲学系主任。尽管年事已高，他仍然活跃于科学界，继续研究电学现象和气体学。1824年，他被选为法国科学院的外籍院士。伏打的晚年充满了荣誉和认可，他的发明和理论被广泛应用于各个领域。1827年3月5日，伏打在科莫逝世，享年78岁。为了纪念他的贡献，国际单位制中电动势的单位被命名为'伏特'(Volt)。科莫市建立了伏打博物馆，展示他的生平和成就，成为科学史上的重要纪念地。
points.descriptionEn: In 1815, Volta returned to his hometown Como and was appointed director of the Philosophy Department at the University of Pavia. Despite his advanced age, he remained active in the scientific community, continuing to research electrical phenomena and pneumatics. In 1824, he was elected a foreign member of the French Academy of Sciences. Volta's later years were filled with honors and recognition, as his inventions and theories were widely applied in various fields. On March 5, 1827, Volta died in Como at the age of 78. To commemorate his contributions, the unit of electric potential in the International System of Units was named the 'Volt'. The city of Como established the Volta Museum, showcasing his life and achievements, becoming an important historical site in the history of science.

supporter.zh: 伏打被誉为电学之父，他的发明开创了电学研究的新纪元。伏打电堆作为世界上第一个电池，为电化学、电磁学等领域的奠定了基础，直接推动了19世纪电气革命的进程。他严谨的科学态度和创新精神，以及对自然现象的深刻洞察，使他成为科学史上的巨人。伏打的贡献不仅限于电学，他在气体学、化学等领域也有重要发现，展现了全面的科学才能。
supporter.en: Volta is hailed as the father of electricity, and his invention开创了 a new era in electrical research. The Voltaic Pile, as the world's first battery, laid the foundation for electrochemistry and electromagnetism, directly driving the electrical revolution of the 19th century. His rigorous scientific attitude, innovative spirit, and profound insight into natural phenomena make him a giant in the history of science. Volta's contributions extend beyond electricity to important discoveries in pneumatics and chemistry, demonstrating his comprehensive scientific talent.

critic.zh: 批评者指出伏打的理论存在局限性，他未能完全理解电流的本质，错误地认为电池产生的电力来源于金属本身的特性而非化学反应。此外，伏打在科学研究中有时过于依赖实验观察而缺乏理论构建，导致他的某些发现未能得到充分解释。他的工作虽然实用性强，但在理论深度上有所欠缺。伏打也未能预见电学发展的广阔前景，对电磁感应等后续重要发现缺乏预见性。
critic.en: Critics point out that Volta's theories had limitations; he failed to fully understand the nature of electric current, incorrectly believing that the electricity generated by batteries came from the properties of metals themselves rather than chemical reactions. Additionally, Volta sometimes relied too heavily on experimental observations without sufficient theoretical construction, leading to some of his discoveries not being fully explained. While his work was highly practical, it lacked theoretical depth. Volta also failed to foresee the vast potential of electrical development and lacked foresight regarding subsequent important discoveries like electromagnetic induction.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，伏打被定义为科学革命的关键人物。他的发明不仅改变了科学研究的方向，也深刻影响了人类社会的技术发展。伏打的名字已成为科学进步的象征，'伏特'作为国际单位制中的基本单位，体现了他的历史地位。在科学教育中，伏打常被作为科学方法论的典范，展示实验观察与理论创新相结合的重要性。他的生平故事激励着一代又一代的科学家，成为科学精神传承的重要载体。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Volta is defined as a key figure in the scientific revolution. His inventions not only changed the direction of scientific research but also profoundly influenced technological development in human society. Volta's name has become a symbol of scientific progress, and the 'volt' as a fundamental unit in the International System of Units reflects his historical significance. In science education, Volta is often presented as a paradigm of scientific methodology, demonstrating the importance of combining experimental observation with theoretical innovation. His life story continues to inspire generations of scientists, serving as an important vehicle for the transmission of scientific spirit.

self.zh: 电是一种非常微妙的作用，它存在于所有物质中，但只有在特定条件下才能被激发和观察到。
self.en: Electricity is a very subtle action, which exists in all bodies, but is only excited and observed under particular circumstances.

others.zh: 伏打先生的发明将永远是人类智慧的纪念碑，它照亮了科学的道路，并为人类福祉开辟了新的领域。
others.en: Mr. Volta's invention will forever be a monument to human genius, illuminating the path of science and opening new fields for human welfare.
